products.name: Nananad
products.description:
One day, my 7-year-old daughter was writing in her notebook. As I watched her fill the page, I noticed something special—her handwriting was remarkably neat, expressive, and naturally beautiful for a child her age.

And then I had an idea.

What if I could preserve this little moment in time?

So, as her father, I decided to turn her handwriting into her very first creative work.

The result is a simple, honest, and wonderfully natural handwritten font inspired directly by the way she writes. It isn't perfectly polished—and that's exactly what makes it special. The subtle imperfections, playful shapes, and organic spacing give each letter a genuine human character that is difficult to recreate artificially.
